# Sandy — what the robot can actually do

Board `sandy-brain-s3`, firmware `0.6.2`.

Three files decide everything below, and this is derived from all three:
`config.h` compiles a subsystem in or leaves it out, `sandy_mqtt.c` declares what the board offers, and `node_provision.py` turns each offer into a control in the app.

## Compiled in

A subsystem set to 0 is not present in the binary. It is not broken and not hidden — the code is not there, so nothing can reach it until the flag is turned on and the board is reflashed.

| Subsystem | State | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `ENABLE_WIFI` | on |  |
| `ENABLE_FACE` | on | ST7789 display |
| `ENABLE_SERVO` | on |  |
| `ENABLE_BUZZER` | on | بيزو سلبي بمخرجين: GPIO 17 + GND |
| `ENABLE_SENSOR` | off |  |
| `ENABLE_MOTORS` | off |  |
| `ENABLE_TOUCH` | off |  |
| `ENABLE_MIC` | off | MAX9814 clap mic |
| `ENABLE_EARS` | off | stereo sound-direction (temp off; merging into VOICE next) |
| `ENABLE_OTA` | off | needs WIFI |
| `ENABLE_MQTT` | on | needs WIFI — cloud body control (mood/servo/buzzer/base) |
| `ENABLE_VOICE` | on | needs WIFI |
| `ENABLE_WAKEWORD` | on | local WakeNet gate for the voice session (needs VOICE) |
| `ENABLE_COMMANDS` | on | local MultiNet "Sandy ..." command words (needs WAKEWORD) |
| `ENABLE_SPK_TEST` | off | temporary: triple-beep to verify amp + speaker |
| `ENABLE_REMOTE` | on | cable-free dev: OTA upload + serial log over WiFi (needs WIFI) |
| `ENABLE_LED` | on | on-board WS2812: idle blue / listening white / talking amber |

## Reachable from the app

Every row here was declared by the board itself in a heartbeat and matched to a control by the catalogue. Nothing appears in the app that the hardware did not first say it had.

| Output | Kind | Shows up as | Control | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mood` | pwm | وش ساندي | enum | `idle`, `happy`, `curious`, `sad`, `alert`, `surprised` … (25 total) |
| `servo` | servo | رقبة ساندي | dimmer | 0–180 |
| `gesture` | servo | حركات ساندي | enum | `nod`, `shake`, `tilt`, `scan`, `dance`, `wake` … (10 total) |
| `led` | pwm | إضاءة ساندي | enum | `off`, `idle`, `listening`, `talking` |
| `buzzer` | buzzer | جرس ساندي | enum | `boot`, `happy`, `curious`, `sad`, `alert`, `error` … (17 total) |
| `mic_l` | audio | المايك الشمال | switch | on / off |
| `mic_r` | audio | المايك اليمين | switch | on / off |
| `mic_l_gain` | audio | مكسب المايك الشمال | dimmer | 0–300 |
| `mic_r_gain` | audio | مكسب المايك اليمين | dimmer | 0–300 |
| `volume` | audio | صوت ساندي | dimmer | 0–100 |
| `speaker_test` | audio | أصوات السماعة | enum | `beep`, `chime`, `alert`, `sweep`, `soft`, `happy` |
| `noise` | audio | عزل الضجّة | enum | `off`, `mild`, `medium`, `aggressive` |
